name: Alpha Vantage
rate_limits: Free: 25 requests/day, 5 requests/minute. Premium: 75-1200 requests/minute, no daily cap.
notes: Official NASDAQ-licensed data provider. Free tier covers most endpoints including stocks, forex, crypto, commodities, and 50+ technical indicators. Real-time US market data requires premium. JSON and CSV output. Very popular with beginners. Good for AI due to broad multi-asset coverage in a single API.
